bio_en: Harutiun Mirakian, a native of Bitlis, fought bravely for a long time against oppressive Kurds and brigands in the Hayots Dzor and Timur districts of Vaspurakan. He failed to reach Sasun after an unsuccessful bomb attempt on the border, went to the Caucasus and Persia, and in November 1904 came to Van, where he stayed until spring 1908. He died in Van and was buried on 3 January 1909, the first fedayi whom the people of Vaspurakan could bury openly, with eulogies by Vramian and Aram and even a Turkish officer.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death in late 1908 or early January 1909.
